title: Legacy OpenAI models shut down on Oct 23, 2026
summary: OpenAI is removing a batch of older models from the API on October 23, 2026, including gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1, o3-mini and o4-mini. Requests to them will fail after that date. Each has a named substitute model.
migration:
Replace each retiring model id string with its substitute from OpenAI's deprecations page (notice of 2026-04-22, 'Legacy GPT model snapshots'):
- gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 -> gpt-5.6-terra
- gpt-4, gpt-4-0613, gpt-4-1106-preview, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- gpt-4o-2024-05-13 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4.1-nano-2025-04-14 -> gpt-5.6-luna
- o1, o1-2024-12-17, o3-mini, o3-mini-2025-01-31 -> gpt-5.6-sol
- o1-pro, o1-pro-2025-03-19 -> gpt-5.6-sol (with reasoning mode pro)
- o4-mini, o4-mini-2025-04-16 -> gpt-5.6-terra
- gpt-image-1 -> gpt-image-2.5-flare
Change only the model id strings (in code, config files or env defaults). Do not change the SDK version, request parameters or response handling. If a string type or union restricts allowed model ids, add the new id to it.
